recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless FHIR-I later reopens the Requirements.statement.conformance cardinality or indexing model.
issue_request: FHIR-39057 asked why Requirements.statement.conformance has cardinality 0..* instead of a single conformance value. It was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to keep the cardinality and add requirements text explaining that a single statement may contain multiple conformance words and need indexing under multiple categories.

FHIR Infrastructure minutes for 2022-10-31 corroborate the Persuasive with Mod motion at 10-0-0. Additional quoted-key Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community discussion.
